brave.note: Brave 1500/mo, 120/day overall; at most 40/day are reserved for this job (holdings only on the first pass).

triggers.note: Triggers only ENQUEUE with a reason (scripts/lib/prospectus/schedule.py); a run window writes. day_move is measured on the CLOSE: the last two daily closes, once per session close after the last report.

run_windows.note: Operator 2026-10-26: reports are queued and run at set times, not ad hoc. The n8n lane prospectus-build fires every 15 min; a window runs once per day from its start until catch_up_minutes later. Off-window fires drain only operator 'Rewrite now' rows.

windows.label: After the close
windows.note: after the 16:00 ET close so the 8% day-move test uses the closing price

windows.label: Pre-market
windows.note: overnight news and earnings for holdings only

watch_batch.note: watch rows go to scripts.lib.prospectus.batch.submit_window when the cost-settings PR provides it; synchronous until then

delivery.note: Host sender scripts/prospectus_deliver.py (timer tradeai-prospectus-deliver.timer). Operator 2026-10-26: Telegram = summary + each report's PDF and Word; email = 'just the audit' (no attachments).

estimate.note: Dry-run cost estimate only; real spend is settled from provider usage.
